# Sausages with broccoli

Chicken and beef sausages with broccoli and gentle spices.

- Net weight: 400 g
- Halal verified
- Without nitrite

## Ingredients

Chicken drumstick fillet, drinking water, beef fat, beef, chicken fillet, poultry skin, broccoli, milk protein, whey protein, milk powder, chicken egg melange, fruit and spice extracts (pomelo, lemon, black and white pepper blend), salt, yeast extract (brewer's yeast), citrus extracts (lemon, lime, orange, pomelo), sugar, spices and extracts (black pepper, nutmeg, allspice), table salt, maltodextrin, glucose, corn starch, flavouring.

**Allergens:** Milk, eggs

## Nutrition per 100 g

- kcal: 230
- protein: 13 g
- fat: 19 g
- carbohydrate: 1.5 g

Calculated estimate per 100 g of raw recipe; not a laboratory value.
